figurative_meaning_bn: পরের উপর জোর খাটিয়ে নিজের কার্যসাধন করা
figurative_meaning_en: Achieving one's own objectives by exerting force or exploiting others
similar_in_english: Stepping on others to get ahead
Climbing the ladder on the backs of others
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে সবসময় পরের ঘাড় ভাঙা করে নিজের লাভ করে।
এই ব্যবসায়ী পরের ঘাড় ভাঙা করে ধনী হয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He always breaks others' necks to gain his own profit.
This businessman became rich by breaking others' necks.
note: The idiom metaphorically refers to ruthless exploitation in competitive environments, common in Bengali folklore and proverbs.
